name: leather-wallah-monorepo
description: Leather Wallah 3-app monorepo — backend + admin + frontend

scripts.dev:be: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm --prefix LeatherWallahBackend run dev
scripts.dev:ad: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm --prefix LeatherWallahAdmin run dev
scripts.dev:fe: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm --prefix LeatherWallahFrontend run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix LeatherWallahBackend install && npm --prefix LeatherWallahAdmin install && npm --prefix LeatherWallahFrontend install
